about.title: Yuba City Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Sutter County recorded 2 traffic deaths alongside 254 injury collisions in the most recent final crash year, numbers that represent real families in Yuba City left to cope with sudden loss. Corridors like Rt 20, Bridge Street, Rt 99, and Garden Highway carry heavy local traffic, and crashes there tend to cluster on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. When a fatal collision happens, surviving family members often face funeral arrangements, lost household income, and unanswered questions all at once. California law gives certain relatives, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, the right to pursue a wrongful death claim, though the window to act is limited. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves; we're a free connection service that can put you in touch with an independent personal injury attorney familiar with these cases. They can review what happened, explain your options, and handle communication with insurers so your family isn't navigating this alone during an already difficult time.

whyChoose.title: What to Understand Before You Act

items.title: Only Certain Relatives Can File
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases to a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in some situations. An attorney can help determine where your family fits.

items.title: The Clock Is Ticking
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity was involved. Waiting can permanently close the door on recovery.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law allows families to seek funeral costs and lost financial support, as well as compensation for the loss of a loved one's companionship and guidance. These claims exist separately from any criminal case tied to the crash.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim in Yuba City?
items.answer: Under California law, you generally have two years from the date of death to file. If a government entity, such as a public road agency, may be involved, the deadline is much shorter, so it's wise to act quickly. An independent attorney can confirm the exact timeline for your situation.

items.question: Does it matter that the crash happened on a road like Rt 20 or Garden Highway?
items.answer: The specific road matters for gathering evidence, such as collision history and any relevant public records, but it doesn't change your family's legal rights. What matters most is documenting how the crash happened and who may be responsible.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action from any criminal prosecution. Even if criminal charges are filed, dismissed, or never brought at all, your family may still pursue a civil claim for your losses.

items.question: What does LawProactive charge for connecting us with an attorney?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and independent attorneys in our network typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. Our goal is simply to help you find the right legal help without adding financial stress.
